## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem this change fixes and what reviewers should expect afterward.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Explain any failed or pending CI gate.

## Related changes

Link related pull requests when this change spans repositories or changes an API
contract.

## Review readiness

- [ ] The pull request targets `main` from a separate feature branch.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed and the changed behavior was verified.
- [ ] Contract and documentation changes are included where needed.
- [ ] Another team member will review before merge; all conversations must be resolved.
